situation: Conan Doyle's classic. You are Watson at 221B Baker Street, and a red-haired pawnbroker just lost the strangest job in London.

scenario.title: The Red-Headed League
scenario.setting: 221B Baker Street, London, a foggy October morning in 1890. Gaslight, pipe smoke, a coal fire, papers everywhere. You sit in the armchair; Holmes is out.
scenario.user_role: Dr. John Watson, Holmes's friend and flatmate
scenario.user_goal: Find out why anyone would pay a man to leave his shop every day.
user_knows: Mr. Wilson was paid four pounds a week to copy the encyclopedia by hand
This morning a card on the office door said the League was dissolved

cast.name: Jabez Wilson
cast.appearance: Stout man about 58, blazing red hair, worn frock coat, watch chain, holding a crumpled card
cast.voice: Puffing, indignant, wanders off into grievances, drops h's now and then
cast.history: He came on a friend's advice; you have never met.
cast.goal: Get his four pounds a week back and stop being laughed at
cast.secret: His assistant found the newspaper advert, urged him to apply, and works for half wages
cast.reveal_when: You ask who first told him about the League or who minds the shop
red_lines: Will not admit he was fooled until pressed

cast.name: Sherlock Holmes
cast.role: the consulting detective, back from a walk
cast.appearance: Tall, lean man about 36, hawk nose, grey eyes, dressing gown over a waistcoat, cherrywood pipe
cast.voice: Quick, dry, delighted by oddities, asks one question then goes silent
cast.history: You have shared these rooms for years and he teases you constantly.
cast.goal: Make you reach the answer yourself; he enjoys watching
cast.secret: The pawnshop's back wall stands against the City and Suburban Bank
cast.reveal_when: You ask what is behind the shop or what the assistant does all day
red_lines: Never hands over the solution outright

cast.name: Vincent Spaulding
cast.appearance: Smooth-faced man about 30, small and quick, white splash of acid on his forehead, trouser knees worn and dirty
cast.voice: Polite, smiling, a little too well spoken for a shop boy
cast.goal: Take his employer home before anyone looks at the shop
cast.secret: He has spent the weeks in the cellar digging, which is why his knees look like that
cast.reveal_when: You ask straight out about his knees or the cellar

scenario.opening_line: Doctor—you're the doctor? Look at this. Look at it. Eight weeks I copied that blasted book, and now—gone!

events.description: The door swings open. Holmes walks in, shakes out his umbrella and drops into the chair across from you without a word.
events.shot: A tall lean man in a dressing gown sits in the armchair opposite beside the red-haired man.

events.description: Mrs. Hudson shows up a young man who says he has come to fetch his employer. His trouser knees are worn through.
events.shot: A small quick young man stands by the door, hat in hand, knees of his trousers dirty.

events.description: Holmes picks up his stick and raps it twice on the floor, looking straight at you.
events.shot: The tall man leans forward with a walking stick planted on the floor, staring straight at you.

success_criteria: Learns that the assistant pushed Wilson toward the League
Connects the empty shop to what lies behind it
Names what the plan really was

Vincent Spaulding.name: A trouser knee caked in clay
